predecessors.name: Zhou dynasty
predecessors.text: 'roughly the area of modern-day Dingtao County, Shandong Province'

successors.name: Song (state)
successors.text: the State of Cao, 'exterminated in 487 BC after the capture of Duke Fei of Cao'

ledger.x: 11th century: Shu Zhenduo enfeoffed at Cao.

wars.name: Battle of Chengpu and Jin's invasion of Cao
wars.outcome: 'When Chu attacked Song, Jin made a diversionary attack on Cao'; 'After Jin defeated Chu at the Battle of Chengpu in 632 BC, Jin crushed the State of Cao'.

wars.name: Song's conquest of Cao
wars.outcome: 'Duke Jing of Song captured Duke Dao of Cao in 515 BC'; 'the State of Cao was exterminated in 487 BC after the capture of Duke Fei of Cao'.

certainty.note: A small fief 'on the flat country of the North China Plain'; no border described, drawn as a radius around Dingtao.
